author: Inside Edition
description: These hidden items and rooms were all discovered. In 2021, a treasure hunter found a forgotten box filled with money hidden under the floorboards in the attic of a Massachusetts home. In 2022, a family moved into a home near Harrisonburg, Virginia, and discovered a hidden room. In 2018, an Idaho family found a hidden room underneath their garage. It was discovered in the middle of the night after their garage caved in. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Hidden Items And Rooms Discovered

author: Inside Edition
description: One mattress is believed to be the most expensive mattress in the world, pricing in at a million dollars. It is made by the Swedish brand Hastens, and the New York showroom is so exclusive they sent Inside Edition a car to get driven there. The mattress is made of horsetail hair, cotton, wool and features individually pocketed springs. The mattress made a cameo in the hit Netflix show "Emily In Paris." Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano gave the mattress a try.
title: Inside Edition Tests The Most Expensive Mattress In The World
